content.text: Error executing tool authenticate_poe: authenticate_poe is unavailable: OAuth here authenticates as Path of Building's registered client, which belongs to another project. This project has no registered client of its own. This is a recorded decision, not a transient failure. See docs/decisions/D01-trade-access.md and docs/reviews/P05-T01.md. Restoring it requires a project-owned route that has been separately approved, not a local setting.

Error executing tool import_character: import_character is unavailable: Reaching the account API requires the borrowed OAuth identity above. Local build import is unaffected: use import_build_code, or load a build file. This is a recorded decision, not a transient failure. See docs/decisions/D01-trade-access.md and docs/reviews/P05-T01.md. Restoring it requires a project-owned route that has been separately approved, not a local setting.
